description: Mint a flow chart, data chart or standard diagram → { ok, ref, url }. Kernel diagram maker (no creative pack). Flow: stations[] { id, kind, label, items? } + edges[] { from, to, label? }; leave out x/y/w/h and viewBox and the boxes are auto-placed in ranks (layout: { direction: 'LR' | 'TB' }), arrows routed around boxes. Charts: marks[] (rect/circle/wedge/line/text/…) in a viewBox { width, height }. Kinds that lower to marks: kind 'sequence' {actors,messages}, kind 'gantt' {scale,tasks}, lanes[], boundaries[]. Typed arrowheads, self-loops, ERD: card edge-notation. Vocab: semantic_search({kinds:['sketch_vocab']}). Illustration / worlds → create_sketch.

folder_ref.description: Optional folder ref (`fld_<…>`) to drop this sketch into. Omit to leave it at root.

manifest.description: Diagram manifest: title, stations[] (flow) and/or marks[] (charts). viewBox { width, height } is required unless every station is auto-placed. edges[], grid and layout are optional. Recipe/world/beats/constellation manifests are not accepted here.

ref.description: Optional stable ref (1-64 chars of [A-Za-z0-9_-]). If omitted, a `sk_<…>` ref is generated. Errors if a sketch with this ref already exists.

title.description: Short title shown in the page header.

name: mint_diagram
title: Mint a diagram
